instruction: Use AutoCAD. Open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\user\Desktop\surface_leak.dxf. Import surface_leak.dxf. Draw a gasket plate rectangle (0,0)-(170,90), four radius 5 bolt holes at (20,20), (150,20), (20,70), and (150,70), and a serpentine leak path on layer SLOT through points (35,45), (65,65), (95,25), and (135,45). Add text ACAD-27. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. [Software] Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.
